torquilstone-postern-parapet-gateway: Raised postern defence and small closed gate over moat, no people or route to parapet invented. V1 broad hinged drawbridge removed: temporary plank/raft are distinct source features; this architectural view no longer asserts a permanent crossing.
torquilstone-postern-parapet: Empty stone parapet and projecting bartisan above small postern; v1 broad hinged drawbridge and chains removed to avoid confusing the temporary moat crossing with the principal drawbridge. Exact masonry illustrative; crossing condition belongs to its own source state.
